summary: This informational RFC overviews the Operations, Administration and Maintenance (OAM) toolset for MPLS-based transport networks. It covers fault management and performance monitoring in the data plane, as required by RFC 5860.

eli5.summary: It is a guide to the tools for checking that a network line works and finding what broke.

questions: what oam tools exist for mpls-tp
how to monitor mpls transport networks
